note: Read 2026-11-03 in FAOLEX's scan of the Bollettino Ufficiale della Repubblica Democratica Somala of 2 June 1973 (its cover page is the Bollettino's), found through UNEP LEAP's record of the Civil Code, and checked against the page image. Majority: 18. The Civil Code (Legge n. 37 del 2 giugno 1973), art. 44: every person who has reached majority, of sound mind and not interdicted, is fully capable of exercising civil rights, and majority is fixed at the completion of the eighteenth year, by the Gregorian calendar; whether the Code is applied alike across the country today isn't shown. Work: null. The Labour Law, Sharci Lr. 36 of 24 December 2024, in the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs' own PDF, has no text layer and was read only by OCR of the Somali scan, so no age is held from it; by that OCR it states light work from thirteen to fifteen and hazardous work from seventeen, but no general minimum age (the blocker papers.ages.blocked.SO holds the attempts). Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Codice Civile (Legge n. 37 del 2 giugno 1973), Bollettino Ufficiale della Repubblica Democratica Somala, Anno IV, N. 6, art. 44 (FAOLEX scan of the official Italian version)
sources.said: Articolo 44. 1. Tutte le persone che hanno raggiunto la maggiore età, sane di mente e non interdette, sono pienamente capaci di esercitare i diritti civili. 2. La maggiore età è fissata al compimento del diciottesimo anno, secondo il calendario gregoriano.
